title: AI Model Releases by Day of Week
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Capability Tracking
description: Bar chart showing which days of the week AI labs ship major model releases on, highlighting the weekday-heavy shipping cadence.

learningObjectives: Interpret a simple categorical bar chart
Connect a data pattern to plausible organizational behavior

keyQuestions: Which day of the week has the most AI model releases?
Why might releases drop off on weekends?
commonMisconceptions: Assuming AI releases happen at a constant rate regardless of day
assessmentOpportunities: Ask learners to propose an organizational reason for the weekday pattern

dataSource.name: AI Release Tracker
dataSource.note: Chart values live in ../ai-release-data/data.json, shared with five other MicroSims.
